headline.zh: 用生成式 AI 优化酶稳定性
headline.en: Optimize enzyme stability with generative AI

scenario.zh: 为洗涤剂配方设计耐热蛋白酶变体，目标是在 60°C 环境下保持活性
scenario.en: Design heat-resistant protease variants for detergent formulas that maintain activity at 60°C

instruction.zh: 确定要优化的基础酶结构
instruction.en: Define the base enzyme structure to optimize

label.zh: 野生型枯草杆菌蛋白酶

output.zh: 已加载 275 个氨基酸序列，热稳定性基线建立
output.en: Loaded 275 amino acid sequence, thermal stability baseline established

output.zh: 已加载改良序列，包含 12 个已知稳定性突变位点
output.en: Loaded improved sequence with 12 known stability mutation sites

instruction.zh: 选择 AI 模型应优先改进的性能指标
instruction.en: Choose the performance metric for AI model to prioritize

output.zh: 简报已更新：重点关注二硫键形成区域和疏水核心突变
output.en: Brief updated: Focus on disulfide bond regions and hydrophobic core mutations

label.zh: 平衡稳定性与催化效率

output.zh: 简报已更新：保护活性位点周围区域，限制突变范围
output.en: Brief updated: Protect active site surroundings, restrict mutation scope

instruction.zh: AI 生成了多个序列方案，检查预测性能差异
instruction.en: AI generated multiple sequence designs, review predicted performance differences

output.zh: 预测熔解温度更高，但催化效率略有下降
output.en: Predicted higher melting temperature but slightly reduced catalytic efficiency

output.zh: 预测热稳定性与活性均衡提升，突变位点更保守
output.en: Predicted balanced improvement in stability and activity with conservative sites

instruction.zh: 确认最终设计方案并生成合成规格
instruction.en: Confirm final design and generate synthesis specifications

label.zh: 生成变体 B 的 DNA 序列
label.en: Generate DNA sequence for Variant B

output.zh: 简报包含密码子优化序列，可下载用于合成订单
output.en: Brief contains codon-optimized sequence, downloadable for synthesis order

output.zh: 简报包含 A 和 B 的对比表及表达载体建议
output.en: Brief contains comparison table for A and B with expression vector recommendations

takeaway.zh: Cradle 用生成式 AI 预测蛋白质突变方案，加速从序列设计到实验验证的研发周期
takeaway.en: Cradle uses generative AI to predict protein mutation strategies, accelerating R&D from sequence design to experimental validation

label.zh: AI 药物发现公司榜单
